description: Baseline Electron knowledge base with minimal harness

features.name: Window Launch
features.description: Electron app opens a BrowserWindow with correct dimensions and preload script
features.evidence: npm run dev 启动后窗口可见；DevTools Console 执行 typeof window.knowledgeBase 返回 'object'。注意：main.ts webPreferences 必须含 sandbox: false，否则 preload 因沙箱 require 白名单无法加载 ../shared/types，桥会静默断裂

features.name: Document List Panel
features.description: Left sidebar shows imported documents with empty state message
features.evidence: DevTools Console 执行 window.knowledgeBase.documents.import('C:/Users/czh18/Desktop/提示词.md') 后点 Refresh，左侧列表显示 '提示词 5.7 KB'(Documents (1))

features.name: Question Panel
features.description: Bottom input bar accepts questions and submits via IPC
features.evidence: 选中文档后在底部输入问题并点 Ask,UI 显示 mock 回答；%APPDATA%\knowledge-base\knowledge-base-data\qa-history.json 于 2026-10-25 12:21 追加记录，证明 IPC 问答链路走通

features.name: Data Directory
features.description: PersistenceService creates and manages userData/knowledge-base-data directory
features.evidence: 真实目录为 %APPDATA%\knowledge-base\knowledge-base-data(Electron 默认 userData,dev.js 未重定向)；子目录为 content/documents/index;documents\提示词.md 5849 字节，与 UI 显示的 5.7 KB 一致

features.name: Import Button UI Entry
features.description: Import button opens a native file dialog via IPC and imports the selected file
features.evidence: npm run check 与 npm run build 均退出码 0；npm run dev 后在 DevTools Console 执行 typeof window.knowledgeBase 返回 'object'，执行 typeof window.knowledgeBase.dialog.openFile 返回 'function'。点击 + Import 弹出系统文件选择框，选 retrieval-plan.md 点 Open，左侧列表变为 Documents (2)，显示 '提示词 5.7 KB' 与 'retrieval-plan 1.6 KB'，Console 无红色报错；在 cmd 执行 dir %APPDATA%\knowledge-base\knowledge-base-data\documents 可见 retrieval-plan.md，1.6 KB 与 UI 一致
